purpose: Preserve historical map-marker records for forensic review without silently promoting old UI data into the authoritative playable mine registry.

sourceInterpretation.rationale: The old engine separately synthesized additional country-profile markers with approximate offsets. Those generated markers are not included here because they were transient derivations rather than a stable independently researched site list.

records.notes: Archived exactly as authored in the historical engine. This is not verified geological data and must not become executable mine state without independent site-level review.
